services.value: Provides routine water/wastewater laboratory testing including Biological Oxygen Demand (5-day, BOD5), Total Suspended Solids (TSS), Percent Solids, pH, Temperature, Ammonia as Nitrogen, Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen (TKN), Nitrate, Nitrite, Phosphorous, Chloride, Fecal Coliform, E. coli, Total Residual Chlorine, Sludge, Fecal Metals. Also offers additional services such as ASA Certified Statistical Analysis of Data, Data Verification, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, Review and Design, Sampling and Analysis Plans, Joint Performance Testing, Investigative Services, and “Non-Standard Technology” reviews and report services.
